# List Workspaces

## Rules
- `ListWorkspaces.execute()` iterate all config workspaces; pair each with `SpecRepository`; return `ProjectWorkspace[]` in config declaration order
- `ProjectWorkspace` immutable props: `name`, `codeRoot`, `isExternal`, `ownership` (`owned`|`shared`|`readOnly`), `specRepo`
- MUST include every workspace from `specd.yaml` (+ local overrides); init failure MAY mark repo unavailable or throw by severity
- `createListWorkspaces(config)` MUST bootstrap each `SpecRepository` with canonical metadata-path semantics; MUST NOT weaker lookup than composition layer
- Config form MUST derive `ListWorkspacesDeps` via `resolveListWorkspacesDeps(resolver)` then delegate `createListWorkspaces(deps)`; resolve `config: SpecdConfig`, `specRepos: ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository>`; MUST NOT inline fs wiring

## Constraints
- MUST NOT modify config or repository state
- `ProjectWorkspace` read-only project-structure view
- MUST NOT pre-load spec content/metadata; only expose repository ports
